title.value: NutriQuébec: a unique web-based prospective cohort study to monitor the population’s eating and other lifestyle behaviours in the province of Québec
title.justification: The title is explicitly given in the citation information of the paper.
title.quote: NutriQuébec: a unique web-­based prospective cohort study to monitor the population’s eating and other lifestyle behaviours in the province of Québec.

analysis.description: This paper discusses the design and methodology of NutriQuébec, a web-based prospective cohort study aimed at monitoring and evaluating lifestyle behaviors such as eating and physical activities in Québec, Canada. It's part of an effort to assess the impact of government health policies on public health.

type.justification: The study is described as a prospective cohort study, which involves collecting and analyzing empirical data.
type.quote: NutriQuébec is a web-­based prospective open cohort study whose primary aim is to provide essential data for the evaluation of the PGPS on the Québec population’s eating and other lifestyle behaviours over time.

name.justification: The study is focused on monitoring public health policies and lifestyle behaviors including nutrition and physical activity.
name.quote: NutriQuébec, the first large web-­based prospective study on diet and health in Québec and in Canada, will provide invaluable data for the evaluation of the PGPS and its action plan to monitor and analyse the evolution of eating behaviours.

name.justification: The study involves collecting and analyzing data on the health and nutritional habits of a population, which is a core focus of epidemiology.
name.quote: The present paper describes the architecture, the vision and the methodology of NutriQuébec, which is a long-term prospective study.

name.justification: The study itself involves creating a dataset based on the questionnaires and data collected from participants.
name.quote: Development of the infrastructure and tools used in NutriQuébec... NutriQuébec aims to: (1) create a cohort of men and women as representative as possible of the Québec adult population.

referenced_paper_title.justification: There is no specific referenced paper for the NutriQuébec dataset since it is a new contribution outlined in this study.
referenced_paper_title.quote: NutriQuébec data will be collected entirely through the web.

name.justification: R24W is a web-based tool mentioned as part of the methods to collect dietary data.
name.quote: We have recently developed and validated a self-­administered and automated web-­based 24-­hour dietary recall (the R24W) for clinical research and large population-­based studies.

referenced_paper_title.justification: R24W is developed as part of the methodologies discussed in this paper, not a referenced tool from another paper.
referenced_paper_title.quote: We have recently developed and validated a self-­administered and automated web-­based 24-­hour dietary recall (the R24W).
